modelling.details:
Alphafold2 predictions fetched from AlphaFold-DB were placed into the map by rigid body fitting.
Termini not supported by the map were trimmed.
Every residue was visually inspected at least once, and its fit to density adjusted if necessary, using ISOLDE.

map.annotation_details: Sharpened map from final non-uniform refinement in CryoSPARC. Sharpening B-factor from Guinier fit: -35.8.
